The URL of your Twenty instance (e.g. ht: Die URL Ihrer zwanzig Instanz (z.B. https://app.twenty.com).
Connect to your Twenty CRM instance.\n\n:
Verbinden Sie sich mit Ihrer Twenty CRM Instanz.

1. Melden Sie sich in Ihrem zwanzigsten Arbeitsbereich an.
2. Gehen Sie zu **Einstellungen** → **APIs & Webhooks**.
3. Klicken Sie auf **+ API-Schlüssel erstellen**, geben Sie ihm einen Namen (z.B. "Activepieces") und kopieren Sie den generierten Schlüssel.

Cursor for the next page: pass `pageInfo: Cursor for the next page: pass `pageInfo.endCursor` from the previous call, with the same filters. Omit for the first page.

Maximum number of fields to return.
Plural API name of the object, e.g. \"co: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.
Twenty filter expression: field[comparat: Twenty filter expression: field[comparator]:value, comma-separated for AND, or and(...), or(...), not(...). Comparators: eq, neq, in, containsAny, is (NULL / NOT_NULL), gt, gte, lt, lte, startsWith, endsWith, like, ilike (% wildcard). Composite fields use dot paths. Examples: emails.primaryEmail[eq]:"ada@example.com", name.firstName[eq]:"Ada", domainName.primaryLinkUrl[ilike]:"%acme%", stage[in]:["MEETING","PROPOSAL"], createdAt[gte]:"2026-01-01". Use deletedAt[is]:NOT_NULL to find soft-deleted records.
Sort expression: field[direction], comma: Sort expression: field[direction], comma-separated. Directions: AscNullsFirst, AscNullsLast, DescNullsFirst, DescNullsLast. Example: createdAt[DescNullsLast].
Maximum number of items to return (1-200: Maximum number of items to return (1-200). Defaults to 60.
Relation depth: 0 returns only the recor: Relation depth: 0 returns only the record's own fields (relations as ids), 1 also embeds directly related records. Defaults to 0.
Comma-separated field names to return, e: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. "id,name,emails,companyId". `id` is always returned. Omit to return every field.
UUID of the record, from List Records, C: UUID of the record, from List Records, Create Record or Get Record (the `id` field).
Field values as a JSON object keyed by f: Field values as a JSON object keyed by field name. Composite fields are objects, e.g. {"name": {"firstName": "Ada", "lastName": "Lovelace"}, "emails": {"primaryEmail": "ada@example.com"}, "domainName": {"primaryLinkUrl": "https://acme.com"}, "amount": {"amountMicros": 5000000000, "currencyCode": "USD"}}. Relations take the related record's id, e.g. {"companyId": "<uuid>"}. Use Get Object to see field names and types.
Update the existing record instead of cr: Update the existing record instead of creating a duplicate when a unique field (e.g. email, domain) already matches. Defaults to false.
Array of 1-60 JSON objects of field valu: Array of 1-60 JSON objects of field values, e.g. [{"name": "Acme"}, {"name": "Globex"}].
Update existing records instead of creat: Update existing records instead of creating duplicates when a unique field already matches. Defaults to false.
Fields to change, as a JSON object keyed: Fields to change, as a JSON object keyed by field name (same format as Create Record), e.g. {"stage": "PROPOSAL"} or {"jobTitle": null} to clear a field.
Permanently destroy the record instead o: Permanently destroy the record instead of moving it to the trash. Cannot be undone. Defaults to false.
UUID of the soft-deleted record, from Li: UUID of the soft-deleted record, from List Records with the filter deletedAt[is]:NOT_NULL.
UUIDs of existing records to check for d: UUIDs of existing records to check for duplicates, from List Records. Leave empty when passing Records.
Candidate records to check before creati: Candidate records to check before creating them, as JSON objects of field values, e.g. [{"emails": {"primaryEmail": "ada@example.com"}}]. Leave empty when passing Record IDs.
UUIDs of the 2-9 records to merge, from: UUIDs of the 2-9 records to merge, from List Records or Find Duplicate Records.
Zero-based position in Record IDs of the: Zero-based position in Record IDs of the record whose values win when fields conflict, e.g. 0 for the first id.
Preview the merged record without changi: Preview the merged record without changing anything. Defaults to false.
Fields to group by, as an array of JSON: Fields to group by, as an array of JSON objects, e.g. [{"stage": true}], [{"address": {"addressCity": true}}] for a composite sub-field, or [{"createdAt": {"granularity": "MONTH"}}] for dates (DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR).
Aggregate names to compute per group, e.g. ["countNotEmptyId"] for a count, ["sumAmountAmountMicros"] or ["maxCreatedAt"]. Pattern: count/countEmpty/countNotEmpty/countUniqueValues/percentageEmpty/min/max/avg/sum + capitalised field name. Omit to get only the group values, without counts.
Order of the groups, as a JSON array, e.g. [{"stage": "AscNullsLast"}] or [{"aggregate": {"countNotEmptyId": "DescNullsLast"}}].
Maximum number of groups to return. Defa: Maximum number of groups to return. Defaults to 50.
